criteria.name: Correct identity and source-backed footprint
criteria.evidence: Official Purdue GIS FID 782 identifies SOKKG / Kappa Kappa Gamma at 325 Waldron Street. Independent Blender inspection matched all 12 of 12 transformed ring points with 0.000000 m maximum residual.
criteria.findings: Identity and plan ring are well supported. The campus GIS is not a certified survey and provides no positional accuracy.

criteria.name: Position, orientation, and scale/dimensions
criteria.evidence: The detailed asset remains in the project campus frame with identity transform. Reopened bounds are {'x': [-404.90387, -379.490173], 'y': [43.455208, 83.147774], 'z': [0.0, 11.017]} m, and the wall base agrees exactly with the mapped 12-point concave outline.
criteria.findings: The footprint and plan scale follow GIS. The west-facing principal facade and entry direction are selected from an unregistered historical photograph; compass-facing orientation is not verified. The modeled roof overhang extends modestly outside the GIS wall ring.

criteria.name: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
criteria.evidence: The February 1952 Kappa magazine page identifies Gamma Delta’s house and shows two main facade levels under a steep dormered roof. The asset includes two main levels and three dormers.
criteria.findings: GIS NUM_LEVELS=1 conflicts with the photo’s two visible facade levels; the GIS field definition is undocumented. Eaves (7.3 m), ridge (11 m), dormer dimensions, and present roof plan are estimates; no measured elevation or current roof drawing was found.

criteria.name: Facade, entrances, and distinctive architecture
criteria.evidence: The historical photograph and caption support white rostone, French Provincial vocabulary, a steep dormered roof, repeated shuttered windows, and a centered entry. The model includes pale stone walls, two window bands with shutters, three dormers, and a centered entry/portico.
criteria.findings: This is a schematic interpretation of a single 1952 image, not a verified current facade. The model has sparse simplified sash bays and a low roof cap across GIS wings; the historical image shows a broader, more steeply articulated roof and facade ornament. Exact window spacing, current additions, material colors, and street-facing elevation remain uncertain.

criteria.name: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
criteria.evidence: Independent reopen inspection found the expected one-object collection, mesh object, identity transform, 0 modifiers, and 0 external unpacked images. GIS raw data, historical image, source observations, build script, validation script, and preview are present.
criteria.findings: The asset preserves its stable path, ID, collection and object names. The library is self-contained.

historical_visual_source.publication: The Key, Vol.69 No.1, February 1952, p.14
historical_visual_source.supports: Two visible main levels, steep dormered roof, pale stone, shutters, centered entrance

Kappa Kappa Gamma, The Key magazine archive

findings: GIS footprint agreement is strong; source positional accuracy remains unpublished.
